d: Company Description TechnoBlue is an ISO 9001 certified organization that provides a broad range of consumer electronics, appliances, imaging solutions, and home networking products across the Qatari market. The company also delivers commercial appliance and air conditioning solutions for diverse applications, including multi-story towers, commercial buildings, housing complexes, and industrial sites. With over a dozen showrooms in major geographic areas and leading malls in Qatar, TechnoBlue offers customers a distinctive “touch and feel” experience with state-of-the-art technology products. The organization continuously invests in service infrastructure to ensure high-quality after-sales support. TechnoBlue’s culture centers on valuing customers and recognizing employees as key assets who drive the company’s success.

Role Description The Marketing Officer role is a full-time, on-site position based in Doha, Qatar. This role is responsible for planning and executing marketing campaigns that promote TechnoBlue’s products and services across consumer and commercial segments. Daily activities include conducting market research, coordinating with sales teams, managing social media and other digital channels, and supporting promotional events and showroom initiatives. The Marketing Officer will analyze campaign performance, prepare reports, and recommend improvements to strengthen brand awareness and customer engagement. Collaboration with internal stakeholders and external partners is essential to ensure consistent messaging and effective market positioning.
